Table 4. Fine-tuning results on OPT-2.7B across tasks. CurvZO combines curvature-guided sampling with adaptive budget selection. US+AB (Uniform Sampling + Adaptive Budget) uses the same adaptive budget selection as CurvZO, but samples parameters uniformly at random. CurvZO (B = ρd) uses curvature-guided sampling with a fixed perturbation budget B = ρd (e.g., ρ ∈ {0.1, 0.4, 0.7}). The best results in each block are highlighted.
Table 5. Hyperparameters used in our experiments. CurvZO and CurvZO+LoRA use the same settings as MeZO and MeZO+LoRA, respectively.
